puzzle.hint: An overwhelming, violent act of seizing — used in Surah Ad-Dukhan to describe a great day of divine vengeance
puzzle.arabicVerse: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
puzzle.verse: 44:16 - The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
